evaluation.justice: Standard multi-lane city main road, clear separation of fast and slow traffic, high accessibility.
evaluation.safety: Complete traffic lights, speed limit signs, monitoring facilities, high driving safety.
evaluation.livability: High-rise residential buildings on both sides, large traffic volume, low quiet livability.
evaluation.sustainability: Neat roadside green belts maintain basic urban ecology.
evaluation.aesthetics: Open wide road, standard municipal traffic facility layout.
evaluation.comfort: Large traffic flow brings noise impact, flat road ensures driving stability.
evaluation.walkability: Independent sidewalk guarantees pedestrian basic safety travel.
evaluation.bikeability: Dedicated non-motor lane, independent and safe commuting riding.
